name: Maize
note: Needs warm conditions and steady moisture at planting. Waterlogging harms seedlings.

name: Beans
note: Sensitive to both drought and waterlogging. Seeds rot in soaked soil.

name: Irish Potato
note: Prefers cool highland conditions. Heavy rain raises blight and rot risk.

name: Cassava
note: Drought tolerant once established. Cuttings need warmth and well-drained soil.
